description: This Java source file defines the class `UnknownEventException`, a custom exception that extends `DittoRuntimeException`. The exception is used to indicate that a certain event is not supported by the protocol adapter, including factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, as well as a builder class for mutable construction.

classes.name: UnknownEventException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating an unsupported event within the protocol adapter. It extends `DittoRuntimeException` and provides factory methods and a builder for instantiation.

classes.name: UnknownEventException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of `UnknownEventException`. It allows setting custom message, description, cause, and href, with a default description initialized in the constructor.

methods.name: UnknownEventException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for `UnknownEventException`, initialized with the given event name to generate an appropriate message.

methods.name: UnknownEventException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an `UnknownEventException` with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: UnknownEventException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an `UnknownEventException` from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: UnknownEventException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers, copying other attributes from the current instance.
